title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 3 multi-source matchup history
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: The Top Picks detail layer made one direct Winsipedia call and displayed a generic no-history message whenever that single path returned no rows, even when prior meetings existed elsewhere.
root_cause: The detail contract had no field-level history router. Exact ESPN team-ID schedule history already existed elsewhere in the certified CFB stack, but Top Picks bypassed it and treated one external provider miss as history unavailable.
patch: Route history per matchup through two independent certified sources: ESPN exact-team-ID schedules plus Winsipedia all-time game-by-game. Reconcile available rows, record aliases/provenance/source attempts, and emit only VERIFIED_HISTORY, VERIFIED_NO_HISTORY_AFTER_SOURCE_EXHAUSTION, or SOURCE_CONFLICT_REVIEW. Provider failure can never authorize a no-history claim.

repair.patch: Forward-port the old Step-4 detail test to the already-frozen V5 page owner. No history, router, model, ranking, probability, or API 2 behavior changed.

live_cert_invocation_repair.root_cause: The cert was executed as a file under devsystem/, making devsystem the Python import root before any live history source call occurred.
live_cert_invocation_repair.patch: Invoke the cert with python -m devsystem.cfb_top_picks_research_v2_step3_history_cert_v1 so repository-root CFB modules resolve normally.
